name: capgo-release-workflows
description: Designs repository-owned release pipelines for Capacitor apps that combine Capgo live updates, native builds (Capgo Build or the team's own CI runners), and App Store / Play publishing, with an automatic OTA-vs-native gate (`bundle releaseType`, `build needed`), staged channels, and rollback. Use when the user wants one release system covering OTA, builds, and store publishing, is replacing a hosted release service with CI they own, or asks how CI should decide between a live update and a store
author: Cap-go
